title: COBOL Examples
description: Each example belongs to one starter lesson. Follow its setup steps before trying it. These examples need the named tools and do not run in this site playground.

examples.title: Display a message
examples.description: The procedure division holds steps. DISPLAY writes a value. STOP RUN ends the program.
examples.code:
identification division.
program-id. lesson.
data division.
working-storage section.

procedure division.
DISPLAY "Hello, Asha!"
stop run.

examples.title: Name a number
examples.description: Working-storage holds data. PIC 9 describes one decimal digit.
examples.code:
identification division.
program-id. lesson.
data division.
working-storage section.
01 PENCILS PIC 9 VALUE 3.
procedure division.
DISPLAY PENCILS
stop run.

examples.title: Add to a count
examples.description: ADD changes a numeric item by adding a value to it.
examples.code:
identification division.
program-id. lesson.
data division.
working-storage section.
01 PENCILS PIC 9 VALUE 3.
procedure division.
ADD 2 TO PENCILS
DISPLAY PENCILS
stop run.

examples.title: Work out a formula
examples.description: COMPUTE assigns the result of a calculation.
examples.code:
identification division.
program-id. lesson.
data division.
working-storage section.
01 ANSWER PIC 9.
procedure division.
COMPUTE ANSWER = 3 * 2
DISPLAY ANSWER
stop run.

examples.title: Choose a message
examples.description: IF checks a rule. END-IF marks where its branches finish.
examples.code:
identification division.
program-id. lesson.
data division.
working-storage section.
01 SCORE PIC 9 VALUE 8.
procedure division.
IF SCORE >= 5
 DISPLAY "Pass"
ELSE
 DISPLAY "Try again"
END-IF
stop run.

examples.title: Choose from several labels
examples.description: EVALUATE selects steps by matching a value. WHEN OTHER is a fallback.
examples.code:
identification division.
program-id. lesson.
data division.
working-storage section.
01 LIGHT PIC X VALUE "G".
procedure division.
EVALUATE LIGHT
 WHEN "R" DISPLAY "Stop"
 WHEN "G" DISPLAY "Go"
 WHEN OTHER DISPLAY "Wait"
END-EVALUATE
stop run.

examples.title: Repeat with a counter
examples.description: PERFORM VARYING updates a counter and repeats until its stop rule is true.
examples.code:
identification division.
program-id. lesson.
data division.
working-storage section.
01 N PIC 9.
procedure division.
PERFORM VARYING N FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL N > 3
 DISPLAY N
END-PERFORM
stop run.

examples.title: Read a table item
examples.description: OCCURS makes repeated data items. Subscripts start at 1 in COBOL.
examples.code:
identification division.
program-id. lesson.
data division.
working-storage section.
01 SCORES.
 05 SCORE PIC 9 OCCURS 3 TIMES.
procedure division.
MOVE 4 TO SCORE(1)
MOVE 5 TO SCORE(2)
MOVE 8 TO SCORE(3)
DISPLAY SCORE(2)
stop run.

examples.title: Store a name
examples.description: PIC X describes a character. A number in parentheses gives the field length.
examples.code:
identification division.
program-id. lesson.
data division.
working-storage section.
01 STUDENT-NAME PIC X(4) VALUE "Asha".
procedure division.
DISPLAY STUDENT-NAME
stop run.

examples.title: Change text case
examples.description: UPPER-CASE is a built-in function that makes letters uppercase.
examples.code:
identification division.
program-id. lesson.
data division.
working-storage section.

procedure division.
DISPLAY FUNCTION UPPER-CASE("asha")
stop run.

examples.title: Measure a text field
examples.description: LENGTH gives the declared length of this text field, including any spaces.
examples.code:
identification division.
program-id. lesson.
data division.
working-storage section.
01 PET PIC X(3) VALUE "cat".
01 SIZE-NUM PIC 9.
procedure division.
COMPUTE SIZE-NUM = FUNCTION LENGTH(PET)
DISPLAY SIZE-NUM
stop run.

examples.title: Name a group of steps
examples.description: A paragraph labels a group of steps. PERFORM runs that paragraph and returns.
examples.code:
identification division.
program-id. lesson.
procedure division.
PERFORM GREET
STOP RUN.
GREET.
DISPLAY "Hello again".
